a: The 2010 Haiti earthquake (French: Séisme de 2010 à Haïti; Haitian Creole: Tranblemanntè 12 janvye 2010 nan peyi Ayiti) was a devastating quake of magnitude 7.0 Mw. Its epicenter lay close to the town of Léogâne in the Ouest department, roughly 25 kilometres (16 mi) to the west of Port-au-Prince, the capital of Haiti. It struck on Tuesday, 12 January 2010, at 16:53 local time, which corresponds to 21:53 UTC.

a: Kilmer is best known for "Trees," a poem that has repeatedly been parodied and alluded to throughout popular culture. Critics have frequently belittled his work, and scholars have tended to dismiss it as too simplistic and excessively sentimental, judging his style to be overly conventional and even outdated. Even so, the broad popular appeal of "Trees" has helped it last. The literary critic Guy Davenport regarded it as "the one poem known by practically everybody." The poem appears often in poetry anthologies and has been set to music on several occasions, among them a well-known setting by Oscar Rasbach that was performed by the singers Nelson Eddy, Robert Merrill, and Paul Robeson.
h: Kilmer is most remembered for " Trees " , which has been the subject of frequent parodies and references in popular culture . Despite this , the popular appeal of " Trees " has contributed to its endurance . Literary critic Guy Davenport considers it " the one poem known by practically everybody . " " Trees " is frequently included in poetry anthologies and has been set to music several times — including a popular rendition by Oscar Rasbach , performed by singers Nelson Eddy , Robert Merrill , and Paul Robeson .

a: SR 243 starts at SR 74 within the San Jacinto Wilderness near Mountain Center in Riverside County, where it is known as Idyllwild Road. From there the highway runs northward along a winding route through the community of Idyllwild. At the intersection with Circle Drive the route turns left and proceeds through Pine Cove. It then carries on through the forest, passing Mount San Jacinto State Park, Twin Pines, and the Morongo Indian Reservation, before navigating a few switchbacks and descending toward the city of Banning under the name Banning Idyllwild Panoramic Highway. The road enters the city as San Gorgonio Avenue, then turns left onto Lincoln Street and right onto 8th Street, finally ending at a diamond interchange with I-10.

a: The planet completes an orbit every four days at a distance of about 5% of the separation between the Sun and Earth. Its host star was observed on several occasions between 2006 and 2009, initially by means of the SuperWASP program and subsequently through dedicated follow-up observations. By analyzing the radial velocity measurements that were gathered, researchers identified WASP-13b, a discovery announced in a journal on 7 April 2009. A later study published in 2011 explored why planets such as WASP-13b become inflated, and in doing so re-examined and re-constrained its mass, radius, density, and age.

a: The island is made up of diverse geological provinces. To the far west, in the vicinity of County Galway and County Donegal, lies a medium- to high-grade metamorphic and igneous complex of Caledonide affinity that resembles the Scottish Highlands. Stretching across southeast Ulster and extending both southwest to Longford and south to Navan is a province of Ordovician and Silurian rocks, which bears similarities to Scotland's Southern Uplands province. Still further south, along the coastline of County Wexford, there is a zone of granite intrusions cutting into additional Ordovician and Silurian rocks, comparable to what is seen in Wales.

Further south , along the County Wexford coastline , is an area of granite intrusives into more Ordovician and Silurian rocks , like that found in Wales .

a: Allosaurus meriani was first described in 1870 by Greppin, who treated it as a species of Megalosaurus on the basis of a tooth from the Late Jurassic of Switzerland. It has at times been assigned to Allosaurus, but recent reviews have classified it either as the dubious theropod species Megalosaurus meriani or as belonging to Ceratosaurus sp. Allosaurus stechowi was described in 1920 by Janensch under the name Labrosaurus stechowi, based on isolated Ceratosaurus-like teeth from the Tendaguru beds of Tanzania. After Labrosaurus and Allosaurus were synonymized, Donald F. Glut catalogued it as a species of Allosaurus, though it is now regarded either as Ceratosaurus sp. or as a dubious ceratosaurian.

a: No. 2 Group, which had been formed on 20 November 1939, was reorganized on 7 March 1940 into one of the first two area commands, designated Central Area. Based in Sydney, Central Area Command was placed in charge of every Air Force unit in New South Wales apart from those located in the southern Riverina and the northern part of the state. Queensland units were likewise assigned to it on a temporary basis until Northern Area could be established. The command's first AOC was Air Commodore Adrian "King" Cole, who had previously commanded No. 2 Group, while his senior air staff officer was Wing Commander Alan Charlesworth.
h: No. 2 Group , which had been established on 20 November 1939 , was re @-@ formed as one of the first two area commands , Central Area , on 7 March 1940 . Units in Queensland were also temporarily assigned to its control , pending the formation of Northern Area . a: In 1972, the geology of Mount Jackson was examined by a team of geologists as part of the Palmer Island investigations. They documented a range of rock types together with underlying volcanic activity. The west-facing slopes display a gentler relief, in contrast to the eastern side, which is marked by a steep, rocky face. Across the area, rock weathering is severe, and the ground is covered with scree and felsenmeer. The team also recorded fresh rock formations as well as the disintegration of bedrock.
h: Mount Jackson 's geology was studied in 1972 as part of the Palmer Island investigations by a team of geologists . They identified various rock types and underlying volcanic activity . The relief of the west facing slopes is gentler when compared to the eastern side , characterized by a steep rocky face . Rock weathering is intense in the area spread with scree and felsenmeer . Fresh rock formations and bedrock disintegration are noted .

a: Sister Wives is an American reality television series aired on TLC that first began broadcasting in 2010. The program chronicles the everyday life of a polygamist household consisting of its patriarch, Kody Brown, along with his four wives and their 18 children. When the series started, the family was living in Lehi, Utah, but in 2011 they relocated to Las Vegas, Nevada.

a: At the 1992 Summer Olympics, he belonged to the celebrated roster, nicknamed the "Dream Team," that also featured Magic Johnson, Larry Bird, and David Robinson. Jordan was the sole player to start in all 8 of the Olympic games. With his playing time kept short because of the many lopsided victories, he averaged 14.9 points per game and ranked second in scoring on the team. Jordan, together with his Dream Team teammates Patrick Ewing and Chris Mullin, are the only members of the American men's basketball program to have captured Olympic gold both as amateurs and as professionals.
